description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter widget for the Downloads Screen, allowing users to initiate, monitor, and display the status of ongoing or completed downloads of books within the application.

classes.name: DownloadsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a user interface to start downloads, show progress, and handle download statuses.

classes.name: _DownloadsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the internal state and logic for DownloadsScreen, including handling user input, starting downloads, and listening for download progress updates.
